# Version 4.150.4
> **Glyph and stencil corrections** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.4)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.4/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.4 corrects glyph-atlas reuse and shared stencil tracking. Windows HarfBuzz native assets also stop triggering the BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Glyph-atlas and stencil bookkeeping corrected** — Partial glyph updates no longer mark earlier evicted glyphs current. Shared stencil-clear bounds are tracked in native coordinates across differing surface origins. ([#5113](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5113), [#5083](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5083))
- **Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BinSkim BA2007** — Consumers no longer need to baseline the disabled-critical-warnings error in libHarfBuzzSharp.dll. The native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected. ([#5123](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5123))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.4

The Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 by scoping vendored-source warning suppression. The bundled HarfBuzz engine and exported ABI are unchanged.
